title: Tracking page for the customer
what: The customer follows this shipment on our branded page, in their language: where it is, the carrier's news, the papers without prices.
failed: The tracking links could not be read.
noRecipients: The customer has no active orders contact with an e-mail address: send it to another address, or take a link to pass on.
copyLink: Copy a link to pass on

other.label: E-mail address
other.hint: The tracking link is mailed to this address only.

passOn.ready: A link to pass on (shown this once):
passOn.copied: Copied. A link to pass on (shown this once):
passOn.once: Nobody can show it again: we keep only a fingerprint of it.

outcome.sent_one: The tracking link was sent to {count} address.
outcome.sent_other: The tracking link was sent to {count} addresses.
outcome.skipped: Nothing was sent: every address already has its link, or bounced.

failed.forbidden: You may not send tracking links of this shipment.
failed.refused: The link was not made: check the address and the shipment's state.
failed.error: The link was not made: try again.

none: No tracking link yet. When the goods leave, the customer's orders contacts get theirs by e-mail.
searches_one: The public search found this shipment {count} time (last {when}): a link for one visit, without papers.
searches_other: The public search found this shipment {count} times (last {when}): a link for one visit each, without papers.
auto: The page stays open until 60 days after delivery.

held.noManage: Only people who manage shipments send tracking links.
held.busy: Wait: the last action is still running.
held.noRecipients: The customer has no active orders contact with an e-mail address.
held.NOT_PACKED: A tracking link is made once the shipment is packed.
held.CANCELLED: The shipment was cancelled: there is nothing to track.
held.RETURNED: The goods came back to us: no new tracking link is made.
held.ENDED: The goods arrived more than 60 days ago: the tracking page has ended.
